title: Cyclic Single-Molecule Magnets: From Even-Numbered Hexanuclear to Odd-Numbered Heptanuclear Dysprosium Clusters

material_class.structural_family: noncentered cyclic hexanuclear Dy6 wheel / ring

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of Dy(OAc)3·4H2O (41.2 mg, 0.10 mmol) and H2spch (36.3 mg, 0.15 mmol) in CH3OH (20 mL) was stirred with triethylamine (0.07 mL, 0.50 mmol). After 24 h, 1-naphthylphosphonic acid C10H7PO3H2 (31.2 mg, 0.15 mmol) was added. The mixture was stirred for another 24 h, transferred to a 25 mL sealed glass bottle, and heated at 100 °C under autogenerated pressure. Yellow single crystals of 1 formed after 96 h as a single-phase product.
synthesis.temperature: 100 °C (solvothermal); room-temperature stirring 24 h + 24 h before heating
synthesis.time: stirring 24 h then 24 h; heated 96 h
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal reaction in a sealed 25 mL glass bottle under autogenerated pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: yellow single crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction formed after 96 h as a single-phase product

properties.summary: Even-numbered cyclic Dy6 cluster showing SMM behavior. χMT at 300 K is 86.69 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 85.02 for six DyIII). χMT decreases below 80 K to 52.78 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K, attributed to mJ depopulation and possible weak intramolecular antiferromagnetic coupling. Magnetization reaches 34.13 μB at 70 kOe and 1.8 K, well below 60 μB saturation, with nonsuperimposed M vs H/T curves indicating anisotropy. Zero-field ac susceptibility (1.8–7.2 K) shows frequency- and temperature-dependent slow relaxation with two Arrhenius regimes: Ueff = 20.3 K, τ0 = 2.6×10−6 s (high T) and Ueff = 4.7 K, τ0 = 9.1×10−5 s (low T). Cole–Cole plots are asymmetric (α ≈ 0.16).

material_class.structural_family: noncentered cyclic heptanuclear Dy7 ring assembled from [Dy3(eddc)] and [Dy2(spch)] units

synthesis.procedure: Solid Dy(OAc)3·4H2O (82.4 mg, 0.20 mmol) was added to a slurry of H2eddc (89.4 mg, 0.30 mmol) and triethylamine (0.07 mL, 0.50 mmol) in methanol (20 mL). After stirring for 48 h, H2spch (72.6 mg, 0.30 mmol) and C10H7PO3H2 (41.6 mg, 0.20 mmol) were added. The mixture was stirred for another 48 h, filtered, transferred to a 25 mL sealed glass bottle, and heated at 100 °C under autogenerated pressure. Deep-brown single crystals of 2 formed after 72 h as a single-phase product.
synthesis.temperature: 100 °C (solvothermal); room-temperature stirring 48 h + 48 h before heating
synthesis.time: stirring 48 h then 48 h; heated 72 h
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal reaction in a sealed 25 mL glass bottle under autogenerated pressure after filtration
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration of the stirred mixture; deep-brown single crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction formed after 72 h as a single-phase product

properties.summary: Odd-numbered cyclic Dy7 cluster showing two-step SMM relaxation. χMT at 300 K is 98.53 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 99.19 for seven DyIII) and falls to 60.10 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K. Magnetization reaches 53.55 μB at 70 kOe and 1.8 K (vs 70 μB theoretical). Zero-field ac data (1.8–8.0 K) show frequency- and temperature-dependent in- and out-of-phase signals with broadened Cole–Cole plots fitted to two modified Debye processes (α < 0.11). High-T Orbach barriers: Ueff(1) = 45.1 K, τ0(1) = 4.4×10−7 s (fast relaxation) and Ueff(2) = 48.7 K, τ0(2) = 2.7×10−8 s (slow relaxation); deviation below 5.5 K indicates Raman/direct/QTM contributions.
